# paddle_checkout_settings (Resource)

The account's checkout URL settings: the default payment link Paddle opens when a checkout is created without a URL of its own. See [Paddle API Reference](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/settings/get-checkout-url). This is a singleton — there is one per Paddle account and environment, so declare at most one of these per account. Paddle requires a default payment link before it accepts any transaction created through the API. `terraform destroy` clears the setting (sets it to `null`) rather than deleting anything.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One per Paddle account and environment. The page at this URL must have Paddle.js
# set up to open the checkout from the ?_ptxn= transaction ID Paddle appends.
resource "paddle_checkout_settings" "default" {
  default_url = "https://example.com/buy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_url` (String) The default payment link: an `https` URL (1–1000 characters, no whitespace). Paddle appends `?_ptxn=` and the transaction ID, and the page must have Paddle.js set up to open the checkout from it. In sandbox any `https` URL is accepted; in live accounts the domain must be an approved checkout domain (see the `paddle_checkout_domain` data source), otherwise Paddle returns `checkout_url_domain_not_approved`.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) Each operation defaults to 120 seconds and is capped at a 30-minute hard ceiling, regardless of what is configured here. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `checkout-url`; the API has no ID for this singleton.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The checkout settings are a singleton; the import ID is always "checkout-url".
terraform import paddle_checkout_settings.default checkout-url
```
